passages.context: PDF page 3 identifies the official Slavonic order in the Roman 1952 Malyj Trebnyk at printed pages 25–71; the 1952 English private-use booklet; Parma's provisional 1994 order; and Passaic's promulgated 1997 revision. The publication describes the 1997 order as widely used in the other eparchies but does not convert that observation into universal legislation.

work.author: Metropolitan Cantor Institute, Byzantine Catholic Archeparchy of Pittsburgh
work.description: A jurisdiction-identified explanation of Christian initiation as celebrated in the Byzantine (Ruthenian) Catholic Metropolia of Pittsburgh, including a bibliographic account of the 1952, 1994, and 1997 service-book sequence. It is evidence about the described Ruthenian order and edition history, not itself a universal Byzantine Catholic ritual book.
